title: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Maharashtra government health assurance programme providing cashless treatment for specified procedures to eligible beneficiaries.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Maharashtra's current beneficiary categories, residence and identity/ration-card or other notified documentation.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
